title: Monolithic Global Store vs Four-Tier State Topology
description: Compare coupling all state in one global store against routing each state kind to its native owner.

before.label: Monolithic Store (Single Global Slice)

metrics.reflows: Global subscribers notified on modal toggle
metrics.dependencies: Manual sync between URL, cache, and storage

before.previewNote: Deep-linking loses sortBy, stale users linger without TTL, and localStorage blocks INP.

after.label: Four-Tier Topology (Explicit Owners)

metrics.dependencies: Native URL, IDB, and cache invalidation

after.previewNote: Back button restores sortBy, cache revalidates stale users, and modal toggles stay local.
